name: Effects Studio
intro: Effects Studio in SmartVideo applies ready made visual and motion effects to your photo or video, with a big catalogue of presets to choose from.

features.image-effects-tab: The Image Effects tab holds still image presets for fast stylized portraits, figurine looks and comic styles from just one photo.
features.nano-banana-tab: The Nano Banana tab has presets for placing yourself in famous scenes, restyling a photo as a decade look, or making a collectible figure.
features.kontext-effects-tab: Kontext Effects are instruction style edits for targeted changes, where you add a short instruction to guide the edit.
features.video-effects-tab: The Video Effects tab turns one photo into a short viral style effect clip using image to video presets.
features.motion-controls-tab: Motion Controls gives a still photo a cinematic camera move, like an orbit or a crash zoom, without describing it in words.
features.advanced-panel: Press Advanced to open options like guidance, steps, seed and negative prompt, so you can fix a seed to reproduce a result or steer away from unwanted looks.
features.compare: After a result exists, the Compare button shows your input and output side by side, so you can judge how strongly the effect changed your photo.
features.motion-graphics-vibe-motion-mode: Switch the top toggle to Motion graphics to describe animated titles, charts or logo reveals, with no source photo needed.

outro: Browse the tabs, upload your media, and let Effects Studio do the heavy lifting on your next creative idea.
